Second alpha of the MMD Motion Importer: a Blockbench plugin that imports MikuMikuDance motion (`.vmd`) as GeckoLib animations on any model, plus a command-line tool that does the same conversions.

This is still an alpha: expect rough edges, and please report what breaks.

## Install

1. Download `mmd_motion_importer.js` below.
2. In Blockbench (4.8 or newer, desktop or web), open File > Plugins > Load Plugin from File and pick it.

## New

- **Progress window:** importing shows how far the conversion is, with a Cancel button.
- **Re-import:** the "MMD Import Report" panel in the Animate tab has a Re-import button that converts the last motion again with the same settings, after you change the model or its mapping. "Change settings" reopens the dialog on that motion. Also under Animation > Re-import Last MMD Motion.
- **New Minecraft Dancer in File > New:** it is now listed with the formats and on the start screen.
- **Skirts avoid the legs:** cloth chains are pushed by the thighs and shins instead of passing through them.
- **Quieter toe tips:** toe-tip motion on a model without toe bones is a small note, no longer part of the "moving parts had nowhere to go" warning.
- **Source model's bone tree:** when you pick the dance's own `.pmx` as the source model, the mapping follows that model's tree where it differs from the standard one (for example an arm twist that reaches the elbow only in part).

## Changed

- **Performer groups were removed from the plugin.** For a dance with several performers, import each `.vmd` in its own project. The command line keeps `convert-group`.
- **Edit Bone Mapping:** the bone column is wider and its tooltip shows the whole line.

## Command line

`miku-motion-cli.tgz` holds the same converter as a single file for Node 20 or newer:

```bash
tar -xzf miku-motion-cli.tgz
node miku-motion.mjs --help
```

## Known limits

- Camera, lights and MMD's own physics are not converted; sound is not written.
- Hair can still pass through arms.
- One stage of a long conversion (hair simulation, leg IK) can hold the progress bar still for about a second.

See the [README](https://github.com/antomarsi/miku-motion-blockbench-converter#readme) for the full guide.
